actions.label: Verify Unicode description alignment in PR #52152

reproduce.title: Check Quick Accent description alignment
reproduce.version_requirement: Compare 0.103.3151.0 preview with a build of PR #52152
prerequisites: Windows test profile with Quick Accent enabled and Unicode descriptions turned on.
setup: Open a text editor and configure Space as the Quick Accent activation key.
steps: Hold a supported letter and press Space to display the character selector.
Compare the vertical spacing above and below the Unicode description on the baseline and PR build.
Select a character and confirm it is inserted; repeat with another supported character set.
reproduce.expected_result: The description is vertically centered without changing character selection or insertion.
